description.narrative: Children's Christmas Calender (Promotion and education material), since 2021 The purpose of the Children's Christmas Calendar is to engage children and their families in developmental issues – in school and at home. The Children's Christmas Calender will continue to expand and evolve as a key activity in the MFA’s engagement efforts towards children and families.
